title: Offensive Security Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

We're looking for an Offensive Security Engineer / AI Pentester to join our dynamic and fastest-growing security team.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Perform advanced penetration testing on web applications, APIs, cloud environments, mobile apps, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Conduct AI-based penetration testing and adversarial assessments against LLMs, AI agents, autonomous workflows, and AI-integrated platforms.
* Simulate real-world attack chains including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool abuse, indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, and agentic exploitation.
* Identify business logic flaws, second-order vulnerabilities, authentication bypasses, and chained exploitation paths.
* Perform software supply chain attack testing, including dependency confusion, CI/CD pipeline poisoning, and package registry attacks.
* Execute red team operations and emulate sophisticated threat actors.
* Develop custom offensive tooling, automation, and AI-assisted attack workflows.
* Perform source code review and security architecture assessments.
* Research emerging attack vectors in AI security, autonomous agents, MCP integrations, and GenAI ecosystems.
* Collaborate with development and security teams to provide actionable remediation guidance.
* Prepare detailed penetration testing reports with comprehensive findings, risk ratings, remediation strategies, and proof-of-concept demonstrations.
* Stay updated with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and AI security research.

Required Skills

Core Penetration Testing Expertise

* Strong expertise in Web, API, Cloud, and Network Penetration Testing.
* Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, and modern attack methodologies.
* Identity protocol testing, including OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC, and JWT bypass techniques.
* Experience with tool-based and manual penetration testing methodologies.
* Experience in white box, grey box, and black box testing approaches.
* Source code review and secure code analysis capabilities.
* Experience in SAST and DAST tools with understanding of common software security issues and remediation techniques.

AI/LLM Security Expertise

* Prompt Injection attacks and variations.
* Jailbreak techniques and model manipulation.
* AI Agent exploitation and autonomous workflow attacks.
* Retrieval poisoning and context manipulation.
* Tool/Plugin abuse and API integration vulnerabilities.
* Multi-agent attack chains and indirect exploitation paths.

Tools & Technologies

* Proficiency with Burp Suite, Nuclei, Metasploit, BloodHound, Sliver, Mythic, and other offensive security tools.
* Knowledge of Nmap, Nessus, Kali Linux, and network reconnaissance tools.
* Cloud security tools and AWS/Azure/GCP security assessment experience.
* Container and Kubernetes security testing capabilities.

Programming & Automation

* Strong scripting/programming skills in Python, JavaScript, or Go.
* Ability to develop custom offensive tooling and automation scripts.
* Experience with shell scripting, Bash, and command-line automation.

Infrastructure & Architecture

* Cloud security knowledge (AWS, Azure, GCP) including IAM, networking, and data storage security.
* Container and container orchestration security (Docker, Kubernetes).
* CI/CD security and DevSecOps environment familiarity.
* IT infrastructure security audit experience.
* Familiarity with EU security frameworks (GDPR, NIS2).

Soft Skills

* Hacker mindset with curiosity, creativity, and a passion for unconventional exploitation paths.
* Ability to think like a real attacker and uncover non-obvious vulnerabilities.
* Excellent communication and technical reporting skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Bonus Skills

* Experience building AI-assisted offensive tooling and automated attack frameworks.
* Published security research, CVEs, or significant bug bounty achievements.
* Public security writeups, whitepapers, or conference presentations.
* Experience with adversarial machine learning or AI red teaming.
* Knowledge of agentic frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP, OpenAI Agents SDK).
* CTF participation or other security competitions.
* OSCP+, OSEP, CEH, CREST CRT, or similar advanced certifications.

What We Value

* Hacker mindset with genuine curiosity and creative problem-solving approaches.
* Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
* Passion for offensive research and emerging AI attack surfaces.
* Ability to innovate beyond traditional scanning and exploit frameworks.
* Collaborative spirit and willingness to mentor junior team members.

Key Requirements

Qualifications

* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 1-5 years of professional penetration testing and security assessment experience.
* Demonstrated expertise in conducting security assessments and red team operations.

Certifications (Preferred)

* OSCP+ (OffSec Certified Professional Plus)
* OSEP (Offensive Security Experienced Penetration Tester)
* CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)
* CREST CRT (Certified Registered Tester)
* eJPT (eLearnSecurity Junior Penetration Tester)
* CRTA (Certified Red Team Analyst)
* OSAI (OffSec AI Red Teamer)

**Designation:**

Offensive Security Engineer / AI Pentester

**Experience Required:**

1-5 years

**Location:**

GIFT CITY, Gandhinagar (On-site)

**Qualification:**

BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc./M.Tech in Computer Science or related field

**Salary Package:**

Best in the Industry

**How to Apply:**

* Send your CV to:
  hr@nowonlinetech.com
* Contact: +91 7600235007
* For inquiries, please mention your penetration testing portfolio, research publications, or CVE contributions.

**Join our team and help shape the future of AI security!**

title: Cyber Security-Gift City
description:
**Cyber Security-GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.**

In this role, you will operate within India's first International Financial Services Centre (IFSC), delivering critical cybersecurity and compliance advisory services to IFSCA-regulated entities, including fund managers, insurance offices, banking units, and fintech firms.

• Position: Assistant Manager – Cyber Security

• Location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat (On-location role)

• Experience: 6–8 years in IT Audit, Cyber Security Advisory, or Information Security Assurance

• Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred (Maximum 30 days notice)

**Key Responsibilities**

• Execute SOC 2 Type I/II engagements, control walkthroughs, evidence collection, and effectiveness testing.

• Conduct ISO 27001 internal audits, gap assessments, and nonconformity write-ups.

• Perform ITGC testing across application environments, including access controls and change management.

• Deliver cybersecurity assessments aligned with IFSCA regulatory circulars and technology risk guidelines.

• Coordinate directly with client IT, InfoSec, and compliance teams, while guiding junior team members.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

• Mandatory CISA certification (ISO 27001 LA or CDPSE is preferred).

• Proven, hands-on experience executing SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 engagements.

• Strong working knowledge of ITGC frameworks, access management, and change management controls.

• Professional experience working within an audit or professional services firm environment.

• Complete willingness to be based full-time on-ground at GIFT City.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Cyber Security Engineer to strengthen security across all our startups. You’ll proactively identify and mitigate risks, manage vulnerabilities, and help drive our organization toward SOC 2 and broader security compliance readiness.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support SOC 2 compliance and audit readiness activities
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) using tools like Burp Suite, Nessus, or Qualys
* Identify and remediate risks aligned with the OWASP Top 10
* Monitor security events using SIEM platforms (Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Sentinel)
* Manage Azure security controls (Azure AD/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Monitor)
* Configure and maintain firewalls and WAF policies
* Manage identity and access management (IAM) practices across systems
* Support endpoint security (EDR) monitoring and response
* Lead incident response activities when security events occur
* Define and maintain security policies and conduct risk assessments
* Implement compliance automation using tools like Sprinto or Vanta
* Write automation and tooling scripts using Python or Bash on Linux systems


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

title: Assistant Manager - Fire and Safety Officer
description:
**About the Role** 
 :
 


* Develop, implement, and monitor fire safety policies, procedures, and emergency response plans across the facility.
* Ensure compliance with applicable fire safety regulations, statutory requirements, and company standards.
* Conduct regular fire risk assessments, safety audits, inspections, and gap analyses to identify and mitigate fire hazards.
* Maintain and monitor the effectiveness of fire detection, alarm, suppression, hydrant, sprinkler, and firefighting systems.
* Coordinate periodic testing, preventive maintenance, and certification of all fire protection equipment and systems.
* Lead emergency preparedness initiatives, including fire drills, mock exercises, evacuation plans, and incident response activities.
* Investigate fire incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions; prepare reports and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Liaise with local fire authorities, regulatory agencies, insurance representatives, and external emergency service providers.
* Conduct fire safety training and awareness programs for employees, contractors, and visitors.
* Manage and develop the fire safety team, ensuring competency, readiness, and compliance with established procedures.
* Monitor contractor activities to ensure adherence to fire safety requirements, permit\-to work systems, and safe work practices.
* Maintain fire safety records, statutory documentation, audit reports, and compliance registers.
* Support business continuity and crisis management initiatives related to fire and emergency situations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance fire safety performance and emergency response capability.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Fire Engineering / Fire \& Safety Engineering / Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* Diploma in Fire \& Safety Management from a recognized institution.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Certification in Fire Prevention, Fire Protection Systems, or Industrial Safety.
* Knowledge of National Building Code (NBC), Factory Act, Gujarat Fire Safety Regulations, and relevant Indian Standards.
* Certification in First Aid, Emergency Response, and Incident Command System (preferred).



  





**Responsibilities – Fire Compliance, Licenses \& Certifications** 




  




* Ensure compliance with all applicable fire safety regulations, statutory requirements, National Building Code (NBC), Factories Act, Insurance Standards, and local Fire Department guidelines.
* Obtain, renew, and maintain all fire safety licenses, No Objection Certificates (NOCs), approvals, permits, and statutory clearances required for the facility.
* Coordinate with Fire Authorities, Government Agencies, Industrial Development Authorities, and other regulatory bodies for inspections, audits, certifications, and compliance reviews.
* Maintain validity of Fire NOC, Occupancy\-related fire approvals, hazardous material storage permits, and other statutory certifications applicable to the site.
* Prepare and submit statutory reports, compliance documentation, and periodic returns to regulatory authorities within prescribed timelines.
* Ensure all fire protection systems, firefighting equipment, hydrant networks, sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, and emergency response infrastructure are inspected, tested, and certified by authorized agencies as per legal requirements.
* Lead closure of observations arising from regulatory inspections, third\-party audits, insurance risk assessments, and internal compliance reviews.
* Maintain comprehensive records of licenses, permits, inspection reports, calibration certificates, testing records, and compliance documentation for audit readiness.
* Track changes in fire safety legislation, standards, and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation across the facility.
* Support external audits related to EHS, customer requirements, insurance compliance, sustainability assessments, and statutory certifications.



  





**Role Specific experience:** 




 Relevant experience of 5 to 10 years
 



  





**Role Specific Behavioural Skills Mandatory Desired:** 




  





 Leadership, Crisis \& Emergency Response Management, Team Management, Innovative, Conflict Management Suitable / Optional, Continuous Improvement Mindset Change Management Cross\-functional Collaboration
